scope: Resolution of the two source conflicts between codex/hfo-col133-authority (afe24111) and codex/haven-finance-integration (0d0e7763) so that neither branch's protections are lost. Rehearsed on local scratch branch scratch/hfo-col133-finance-integration (d968bc30, detached merge of origin/main fad17dcc + Finance + COL-133, Finance-first numbering). Not pushed, not applied, not deployed.

conflict_1.finance_protection: F01: one immutable CSV snapshot materialized in PostgreSQL under an MVCC snapshot (no REST paging caps or drift), immutable snapshot/event evidence, retry returns identical bytes, authority rechecked at request, materialization and retrieval, effective-role write guard.
conflict_1.col133_protection: Every page read under current RLS including the COL-133 restrictive audit_log policies; session, profile, explicit current site grant and job authority revalidated before bytes are returned; no service client; cached counts cannot expose prior scope.
conflict_1.loss_if_finance_taken_alone: haven.materialize_audit_export is SECURITY DEFINER and reads public.audit_log directly, bypassing the COL-133 RESTRICTIVE policies (legacy evidence paths, unclassified tasks, operation_audit_log, cards/meetings, aggregate snapshots, other-site assets), and its scope check uses the legacy haven.has_facility_access rather than the explicit, expiring COL-133 site grant.
conflict_1.loss_if_col133_taken_alone: Edge-side paging with no immutable snapshot; retries requery live data; F01's request/materialize/retrieve evidence and write guards absent.
conflict_1.resolution: Keep the Finance handler (thin Edge, DB RPCs). Add a reconcile migration after both branches' migrations that (a) defines haven.operation_audit_row_current(audit_log) with the identical predicate to the two COL-133 restrictive policies, (b) defines haven.can_export_audit_scope_current = F01 scope AND haven.operation_facility_access, (c) replaces materialize/retrieve to use both before and after materialization and to filter rows with (a), and (d) revokes the superseded COL-133 completion RPC from authenticated so no job can be completed without a snapshot.
conflict_1.proof: review_audit_export_current_authority.sql: snapshot id set equals the RLS-visible id set for a site admin (3 of 9 fixture rows) and for an owner across two sites; restricted markers absent from CSV bytes; expired COL-133 grant denies retrieval and materialization while legacy access still holds; owner cannot request a site B export without a current site B grant; superseded completion RPC denied and pending job unchanged. Finance's own F01 suite passes unchanged in intent.

conflict_2.resolution: Union of both sides: Finance's facility-timezone/business_today calendar fixture and future-arrival rejection, plus COL-133's witness session, explicit facility subject classification, forged-witness denial and authenticated witness dual sign. Replays PASS.

changes: Owner actor receives an explicit user_facility_access row for site B before the owner-B export (COL-133 requires an explicit current grant for corporate roles; Finance previously relied on role alone).

Forge-completion denial asserted on a still-visible pending job the owner requested, plus an explicit assertion that the completed job is hidden (COL-133 hides completed jobs from the requester, so the original UPDATE matched no row).

retired.reason: Compiled and exercised the replaced Edge source; its five guarantees are now asserted against the database by the reconcile probe.
